Soya Boiled Rice
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, December 2, 2010 - 9:51pm

Ingredients




1 kilogram Rice ½ (soaked in water for 1 hour)
2 cups Fresh Soya chopped ½
3 teaspoons Oil 1- 2
4 glass Water 10

Preparation

1 Fry soya in oil for 2-3 mintes 2 Add water and then soaked rice. 3 Boil on high flame till rice is tender 4 Serve with curry, raita, salad.

About


Boiled rice are prepared in a number of ways. Boiling of Rice with soya give soya flavored rice.
